allowed_media_type_id.description: Filter by allowed media type ID(s)

commission_cpc.description: Filter on the cost per click a program pays, in the currency defined by currency_code, as an amount or as a range (json: gt, gte, lt, lte, e.g. {"gte":0.1,"lte":1})

commission_fixed.description: Filter on the fixed commission a program pays, in the currency defined by currency_code, as an amount or as a range (json: gt, gte, lt, lte, e.g. {"gte":5,"lte":25})

commission_ratio.description: Filter on the commission percentage a program pays, as a percentage or as a range (json: gt, gte, lt, lte, e.g. {"gte":5,"lte":25})

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response. Omit to start from the first page.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. The data of the fields left out is not fetched

limit.description: Maximum results per page (1-1000, default 100). Only used when starting a new list (no cursor supplied); once a cursor is used, its own limit applies and this is ignored.

order_by.description: Field to sort by (id, advertiser_id, name, currency_code, start_date)

search_term.description: Search by program name (partial match) or by program ID (exact match on a term of digits only)

similar_to_id.description: Return the campaigns that resemble the given campaign ID(s), most similar first. Resemblance is based on the English campaign descriptions. The campaigns asked about are not part of the answer, and this ordering replaces order_by

start_date.description: Filter on the date a program started, as a date (Y-m-d) or as a range (json: gt, gte, lt, lte, e.g. {"gte":"2024-01-01","lte":"2024-12-31"})
